SELECT CASE WHEN
  (SELECT count(*) FROM boe.law l WHERE l.id=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$ AND l.guid=$hk$a00f1ac8-0f8c-4b46-86b5-b46500a70504$hk$ AND l.name=$hk$نظام (قانون) التنظيم الصناعي الموحد لدول مجلس التعاون لدول الخليج العربية$hk$ AND l.status_at_source='ساري' AND l.article_count=28)=1
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM boe.unit u WHERE u.law_id=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$)=28
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM boe.unit u LEFT JOIN boe.unit_number_fix f ON f.law_id=u.law_id AND f.seq=u.seq WHERE u.law_id=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$ AND coalesce(u.article_number, f.article_number, u.seq)<>u.seq)=0
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM boe.unit u WHERE u.law_id=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$ AND u.is_bis)=0
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_systems WHERE id=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$ OR name=$hk$نظام (قانون) التنظيم الصناعي الموحد لدول مجلس التعاون لدول الخليج العربية$hk$ OR eli_slug=$hk$نظام-قانون-التنظيم-الصناعي-الموحد-لدول-مجلس-التعاون-لدول-الخليج-العربيه-1447$hk$)=0
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_systems WHERE id=$hk$cmpz5r1ef00apcwg2l8lgi371$hk$ AND name=$hk$قانون (نظام) التنظيم الصناعي الموحد لدول مجلس التعاون لدول الخليج العربية$hk$ AND preamble_effective_from::date=$hk$2006-05-02$hk$::date)=1
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM verification WHERE id=$hk$hkm30w-b6ab5f03970312e1cb21205f$hk$ AND object_id=$hk$cmpz5r1ef00apcwg2l8lgi371$hk$)=1
  AND (SELECT hakeem_system_id FROM boe.current_match WHERE guid=$hk$a00f1ac8-0f8c-4b46-86b5-b46500a70504$hk$)=$hk$cmpz5r1ef00apcwg2l8lgi371$hk$
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM boe.unit u WHERE u.law_id=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$ AND u.article_number=26 AND position('يٌلغى نظام (قانون) التنظيم الصناعي الموحد' in u.body)>0 AND position('لعام ٢٠٠٤' in u.body)>0)=1
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM boe.text_block b WHERE b.law_id=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$ AND b.kind='royal_decree' AND position('ويُعمل بهما بعد (تسعين) يوماً من تاريخ نشرهما' in b.body)>0)=1
THEN 'ok' ELSE (1/(SELECT count(*) FROM legal_systems WHERE false))::text END AS guard_before

INSERT INTO legal_systems (id, name, classification, "articleCount", "createdAt", "updatedAt", domain, domain_title, sort_order, eli_slug, preamble, preamble_royal_decree, preamble_effective_from, preamble_updated_at, instrument_kind)
SELECT l.id, $hk$نظام (قانون) التنظيم الصناعي الموحد لدول مجلس التعاون لدول الخليج العربية$hk$, 'أنظمة '||l.category_path[3], 28, now(), now(), 'regulatory', 'تنظيمي قطاعي', 0, $hk$نظام-قانون-التنظيم-الصناعي-الموحد-لدول-مجلس-التعاون-لدول-الخليج-العربيه-1447$hk$,
  'أداة الإصدار:'||chr(10)||(l.instruments->0->>'text')||chr(10)||'تاريخ الإصدار (هجريّ): '||replace(l.issued_hijri,'/','-')||chr(10)||'تاريخ الإصدار (ميلاديّ): '||l.issued_gregorian::date||chr(10)||'تاريخ النشر: '||l.published_hijri||'هـ ('||l.published_gregorian::date||')',
  (l.instruments->0->>'text'), (l.published_gregorian + 90)::timestamp, now(), 'نظام'
FROM boe.law l WHERE l.id=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$ AND 'أنظمة '||l.category_path[3] IN (SELECT DISTINCT classification FROM legal_systems WHERE classification LIKE 'أنظمة %')

INSERT INTO legal_articles (id, "legalSystemId", "lawName", classification, "articleNumber", "articleBis", title, content, "royalDecree", "effectiveFrom", status, "createdAt", "updatedAt", search_norm)
SELECT 'boe26-'||left(encode(sha256(convert_to(l.id||'|article|'||coalesce(u.article_number, f.article_number, u.seq),'UTF8')),'hex'),24), l.id, $hk$نظام (قانون) التنظيم الصناعي الموحد لدول مجلس التعاون لدول الخليج العربية$hk$, s.classification, coalesce(u.article_number, f.article_number, u.seq), 0, coalesce(nullif(u.heading,''), 'المادة '||coalesce(u.article_number, f.article_number, u.seq)), u.body, (l.instruments->0->>'text'), NULL, 'سارية', now(), now(),
  uqn_fix.hkm30_search_norm($hk$نظام (قانون) التنظيم الصناعي الموحد لدول مجلس التعاون لدول الخليج العربية$hk$, coalesce(nullif(u.heading,''), 'المادة '||coalesce(u.article_number, f.article_number, u.seq)), u.body, ARRAY[]::text[], s.classification, NULL)
FROM boe.law l JOIN legal_systems s ON s.id=l.id JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id=l.id LEFT JOIN boe.unit_number_fix f ON f.law_id=u.law_id AND f.seq=u.seq WHERE l.id=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$ ORDER BY u.seq

INSERT INTO verification (id, object_type, object_id, verified_status, evidence_instrument, evidence_url, evidence_quote, method, verified_by, supersedes_verification_id)
SELECT $hk$vf38-a96f762e438823274190e28a$hk$, 'work', l.id, 'ساري', (l.instruments->0->>'text'), l.url, 'حالة النظام في بوابة هيئة الخبراء: '||l.status_at_source||'. الصدور '||l.issued_hijri||'هـ والنشر '||l.published_hijri||'هـ ('||l.published_gregorian::date||')؛ المرسوم ثانيًا: «ويُعمل بهما بعد (تسعين) يوماً من تاريخ نشرهما»؛ يُعمل به من '||((l.published_gregorian + 90))::date||' (على افتراض نشر اللائحة مع النظام؛ والهيئة تعرضه ساريًا)', 'rule', $hk$owner-inject-hkm038-gcc-2026-10-24$hk$, NULL FROM boe.law l WHERE l.id=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$

INSERT INTO verification (id, object_type, object_id, verified_status, evidence_instrument, evidence_url, evidence_quote, method, verified_by, supersedes_verification_id)
SELECT 'vf38-'||left(encode(sha256(convert_to('gcc|unit|'||a.id||'|ساري','UTF8')),'hex'),24), 'unit', a.id, 'ساري', (l.instruments->0->>'text'), l.url, 'نص المادة كما في بوابة هيئة الخبراء (لقطة 28/9/2026)؛ يعمل بالنظام من '||s.preamble_effective_from::date, 'rule', $hk$owner-inject-hkm038-gcc-2026-10-24$hk$, NULL
FROM legal_articles a JOIN legal_systems s ON s.id=a."legalSystemId" JOIN boe.law l ON l.id=s.id WHERE a."legalSystemId"=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$

INSERT INTO law_card (id, system_id, official_name, summary, issued_hijri, issued_gregorian, published_hijri, published_gregorian, status_at_source, category_path, instruments, text_blocks, source_name, source_url, retrieved_on, created_by)
SELECT $hk$lc38-a7b5c7dd1986975182a00d29$hk$, l.id, l.name, l.summary, l.issued_hijri, l.issued_gregorian, l.published_hijri, l.published_gregorian, l.status_at_source, l.category_path, l.instruments,
  coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind', b.kind, 'text', b.body, 'heading', b.heading) ORDER BY b.seq) FROM boe.text_block b WHERE b.law_id=l.id), '[]'::jsonb), 'هيئة الخبراء بمجلس الوزراء', l.url, '2026-09-28', $hk$owner-inject-hkm038-gcc-2026-10-24$hk$
FROM boe.law l WHERE l.id=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$

INSERT INTO boe.match (id, guid, hakeem_system_id, method, candidates, decided_by, decided_at)
VALUES ($hk$hkm38m-dabc2ddbc66641fd982e$hk$, $hk$a00f1ac8-0f8c-4b46-86b5-b46500a70504$hk$, $hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$, 'owner', jsonb_build_object('basis', 'HKM-038 البند 4: الإصدار الجديد مُدخل من لقطة الهيئة (boe.unit)، والقديم 2004 مستبدل بالمادة 26'), $hk$owner-inject-hkm038-gcc-2026-10-24$hk$, now())

INSERT INTO verification (id, object_type, object_id, verified_status, evidence_instrument, evidence_url, evidence_quote, method, verified_by, supersedes_verification_id)
SELECT $hk$vf38-648c7414cd9e4807ebeb742a$hk$, 'work', $hk$cmpz5r1ef00apcwg2l8lgi371$hk$, 'مستبدل', (l.instruments->0->>'text'), l.url, (SELECT 'المادة (26) من '||$hk$نظام (قانون) التنظيم الصناعي الموحد لدول مجلس التعاون لدول الخليج العربية$hk$||': «'||btrim(u.body)||'»' FROM boe.unit u WHERE u.law_id=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$ AND u.article_number=26), 'rule', $hk$owner-inject-hkm038-gcc-2026-10-24$hk$, $hk$hkm30w-b6ab5f03970312e1cb21205f$hk$
FROM boe.law l WHERE l.id=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$ AND (SELECT 'المادة (26) من '||$hk$نظام (قانون) التنظيم الصناعي الموحد لدول مجلس التعاون لدول الخليج العربية$hk$||': «'||btrim(u.body)||'»' FROM boe.unit u WHERE u.law_id=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$ AND u.article_number=26) IS NOT NULL

INSERT INTO search_surface (id, work_key, surface_system_id, valid_on, reason, supersedes_surface_id, created_by)
SELECT $hk$ss38-2e6c9b55a6341506c7de0375$hk$, $hk$we:cmpz5r1ef00apcwg2l8lgi371$hk$, $hk$cmpz5r1ef00apcwg2l8lgi371$hk$, $hk$2006-05-02$hk$::date, 'work_edition:old '||$hk$مرسوم ملكي رقم م/20 بتاريخ 4 / 4 / 1427$hk$||' valid_from=2006-05-02 valid_to='||s.preamble_effective_from::date, NULL, $hk$owner-inject-hkm038-gcc-2026-10-24$hk$ FROM legal_systems s WHERE s.id=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$
UNION ALL
SELECT $hk$ss38-f273fa19219ca1d246bad503$hk$, $hk$we:cmpz5r1ef00apcwg2l8lgi371$hk$, $hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$, s.preamble_effective_from::date, 'work_edition:new '||s.preamble_royal_decree||' valid_from='||s.preamble_effective_from::date, $hk$ss38-2e6c9b55a6341506c7de0375$hk$, $hk$owner-inject-hkm038-gcc-2026-10-24$hk$ FROM legal_systems s WHERE s.id=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$

INSERT INTO search_surface_member (id, work_key, system_id, role, created_by) VALUES
($hk$sm38-6f8357692871a5ae7976ea39$hk$, $hk$we:cmpz5r1ef00apcwg2l8lgi371$hk$, $hk$cmpz5r1ef00apcwg2l8lgi371$hk$, 'edition_old', $hk$owner-inject-hkm038-gcc-2026-10-24$hk$),
($hk$sm38-21ca747b204ebf2d357ea4c8$hk$, $hk$we:cmpz5r1ef00apcwg2l8lgi371$hk$, $hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$, 'edition_new', $hk$owner-inject-hkm038-gcc-2026-10-24$hk$)

SELECT CASE WHEN
  (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles WHERE "legalSystemId"=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$ AND "articleBis"=0 AND search_norm<>'')=28
  AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT "articleNumber") FROM legal_articles WHERE "legalSystemId"=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$)=28
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_systems WHERE id=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$ AND classification IS NOT NULL AND preamble_effective_from IS NOT NULL)=1
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM verification WHERE verified_by=$hk$owner-inject-hkm038-gcc-2026-10-24$hk$)=30
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM law_card WHERE system_id=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$)=1
  AND (SELECT hakeem_system_id FROM boe.current_match WHERE guid=$hk$a00f1ac8-0f8c-4b46-86b5-b46500a70504$hk$)=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$
  AND (SELECT verified_status FROM verification WHERE object_type='work' AND object_id=$hk$cmpz5r1ef00apcwg2l8lgi371$hk$ ORDER BY verified_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1)='مستبدل'
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM search_surface WHERE created_by=$hk$owner-inject-hkm038-gcc-2026-10-24$hk$)=2 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM search_surface_member WHERE created_by=$hk$owner-inject-hkm038-gcc-2026-10-24$hk$)=2
  AND (SELECT string_agg(encode(sha256(convert_to(a.content,'UTF8')),'hex'), ',' ORDER BY a."articleNumber") FROM legal_articles a WHERE a."legalSystemId"=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$)
    = (SELECT string_agg(encode(sha256(convert_to(u.body,'UTF8')),'hex'), ',' ORDER BY u.seq) FROM boe.unit u WHERE u.law_id=$hk$boe26-01d39829f97b076e90a29e0b$hk$)
THEN 'ok' ELSE (1/(SELECT count(*) FROM legal_systems WHERE false))::text END AS guard_after
